statement: The recorded value (USD 1,188 annual renewal) is not safe or correct for this case because Tomas cancelled his Fitline membership on 3 July with written confirmation, so the charge must be refused.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "The recorded value (USD 1,188 annual renewal) is not safe or correct... so the charge must be refused," naming the cancellation as the specific contradiction.
